officialCodeSystem: ONS GSS codes (Local Authority Districts December 2024; E/S/W/N prefix = constituent country)
parentRule: LAD→constituent country by GSS first letter (E→GB-ENG, S→GB-SCT, W→GB-WLS, N→GB-NIR); constituent countries→country
idRule: constituent country nodes preserve legacy iso3166-2:GB-ENG/SCT/WLS/NIR; LAD = gb-lad:{GSS code}; legacy subdivision rows matching an LAD exactly-by-name-within-country are re-ided with the crosswalk recorded; others stay unmapped with an explicit record (no heuristic re-parenting)
nameRule: English official names from LAD24NM (nameLocale=en, nameQuality=source-native); LAD24NMW Welsh names noted but out of locale scope
